title: Princess Power
intro: [excited] Welcome, your royal highnesses, to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight we skip the tiaras and celebrate what princesses can DO: their skills, their songs, and their adorable pets. [laughs] Ready? Let's show 'em some princess power!

art.prompt: A sunlit forest clearing with a bow and arrows, a frying pan, a stack of books and a canoe paddle arranged like trophies on a mossy stone, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Brave Heart
categories.intro: We open in the Scottish Highlands with Brave. [chuckles] Change your fate... with a good answer.

art.prompt: Misty Scottish highlands with a circle of ancient standing stones and tiny glowing blue spirit lights drifting through the fog, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Merida's wild, curly hair is this color.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is red! Pixar animators built new software just to make all those curls bounce.

clues.clue: Merida's magic cake turns her mother, Queen Elinor, into this animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a bear! [laughs] Next time, Merida, just talk to your mom.

clues.clue: Merida follows these glowing blue spirits, which are said to lead you to your fate.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is will-o'-the-wisps! [whispers] Follow them... if you dare.

clues.clue: Merida rides this loyal black Clydesdale horse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Angus! A big horse, but he gets scared easily. [chuckles] Relatable.

clues.clue: This giant demon bear was once a prince who wanted more power.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mor'du! He cost King Fergus a leg. [gasps] That is a nerd-level answer.

categories.title: Hidden Talents
categories.intro: Princesses have skills, people! Name the talent or the thing they're famous for doing.

art.prompt: An open wooden trunk spilling out art brushes, a cookbook, a star chart and a pair of ice skates in a cozy attic, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Elsa can create this out of thin air with her hands.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is ice and snow! She built a whole palace in one song. [laughs] I can't build a shelf.

clues.clue: Tiana works two waitress jobs to save up for this dream.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is her own restaurant! Hard work and a little magic made Tiana's Palace a reality.

clues.clue: Belle's favorite pastime, which makes the townsfolk think she's odd.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is reading! [chuckles] And the Beast gave her a whole library. Smart guy.

clues.clue: Moana learns this ancient Polynesian skill of navigating by stars, waves and wind.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is wayfinding! We tell the ocean where to go. [excited] Literally.

clues.clue: Rapunzel's hair glows and heals when she sings this song, known as 'Flower, Gleam and Glow.'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Healing Incantation! Make the clock reverse... and bring back what once was mine.

categories.title: Pet Projects
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a princess's animal pal. Name the princess who owns it.

art.prompt: A cozy royal stable and garden filled with bird nests, a fishbowl, a cat bed and a dog bowl, warm morning light, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which princess owns this pet?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Rapunzel! Pascal the chameleon changes color when he's annoyed. Which is often.

media.prompt: A small green chameleon perched on a sunny windowsill beside paint brushes and a long braid of golden hair, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which princess owns this pet?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jasmine! Rajah the tiger is basically a giant kitty. With very sharp manners.

media.prompt: A large Bengal tiger lounging beside a fountain in a lush Arabian palace garden with domed towers behind, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which princess owns these pets?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pocahontas! Meeko the raccoon and Flit the hummingbird. [laughs] Meeko eats everything.

media.prompt: A chubby raccoon and a tiny hummingbird sitting on a mossy branch beside a river and autumn forest, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which princess owns these pets?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! Pua the pig and Heihei the rooster. [chuckles] One is smart. One is... Heihei.

media.prompt: A small spotted pot-bellied piglet and a scruffy rooster in an outrigger canoe on a turquoise lagoon, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Which princess owns this pet?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella! Bruno the bloodhound dreams of chasing Lucifer the cat. [whispers] Deep cut.

media.prompt: A droopy-eared bloodhound dog asleep on a rug beside a fireplace in an old château kitchen, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Royal Engagements
categories.intro: To the parks! Real photos of princess places around the world. [excited] Name what you see.

art.prompt: A grand banquet hall with wooden beams, banners and candlelit chandeliers, long tables set for a royal feast, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Tiana's Bayou Adventure, seen here, replaced this classic log flume ride.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Splash Mountain! Tiana's version debuted at Magic Kingdom in June 2024, then at Disneyland that November.

clues.clue: Princesses dine with guests at Akershus Royal Banquet Hall, seen here, in this EPCOT World Showcase pavilion.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Norway! The hall is modeled on Oslo's real Akershus Fortress. [chuckles] Bring your appetite.

source.author: HarshLight from San Jose, CA, USA

clues.clue: Hong Kong Disneyland opened the world's first Frozen land in 2023. It recreates this kingdom.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Arendelle! World of Frozen opened in November 2023. [excited] Summer Snow Day, every day.

clues.clue: Fantasy Springs, home of Frozen Kingdom and Rapunzel's Forest, opened in 2024 at this park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tokyo DisneySea! Fantasy Springs opened in June 2024, with a Peter Pan area too.

clues.clue: This Magic Kingdom dark ride, seen here, closed in 2012. Its space now hosts princess meet-and-greets. Name the new attraction.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is Princess Fairytale Hall! It opened in 2013, and there's still a little Snow White book inside as a tribute.

categories.title: Royal Ballads
categories.intro: Our fan category is all about princess power ballads. Name the princess who sings it! [chuckles] Singing along is optional.

art.prompt: A grand royal music room with a golden harp, sheet music fluttering in the air and sunlight through stained-glass windows, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: 'Let It Go'
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Elsa! [laughs] And now it's stuck in your head forever. You're welcome.

clues.clue: 'How Far I'll Go'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Moana! Written by Lin-Manuel Miranda, and Oscar-nominated.

clues.clue: 'When Will My Life Begin'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rapunzel! Chores, painting, baking, and then... still stuck in a tower.

clues.clue: 'Almost There'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tiana! Sung by Anika Noni Rose, with a gorgeous Art Deco dream sequence.

clues.clue: 'Just Around the Riverbend'
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Pocahontas! She paddles right off a waterfall while singing it. [gasps] Do not try that at home.
